messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Oscilloscope in Aerospace / Defense, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

【推論】建議主軸：Current vault evidence points first to UAV oscilloscope opportunities where R&S RTO / MXO are already mapped to UAV image interfaces, motor/gimbal, and power categories, while satellite and defense-5G/O-RU opportunities need follow-up because their oscilloscope linkage is less specific or indirect [36][37][41][44][97].
### 推薦先賣
1. **UAV image-processing / camera-interface validation is the clearest Oscilloscope opportunity, because UAVEcoChain maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO in the 影像處理-相機 category [36][37][41].**
2. **UAV motor/gimbal and battery/power electronics are also directly supported, because UAVEcoChain maps 其昜先進 in 馬達動力雲台 to R&S MXO and 德鑫新技 in 電池電源 to R&S MXO [36][37][41].**
3. **Military / aviation drone EMC and EME is a strong measurement-demand area but not a verified Oscilloscope product mapping, because the drone proposal covers MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, system-level EME, HPM, EMP, lightning, RADHAZ, and platform radiated emission, while its standard R&S systems are TS9975, TS9982, and TS8997 rather than RTO/MXO [1][63][65][67][68].**
4. **Satellite / satcom supply-chain work is a follow-up Oscilloscope opportunity, because SatelliteEcoChain says satellite / satcom R&S solution mappings include Oscilloscope, but it does not identify the exact oscilloscope model, option, or test use case [44].**
5. **Defense private-5G / O-RU lab work is an adjacent opportunity, because the A&D 5G-resilience material identifies tactical-edge private 5G, smart jamming, EW, drones, low latency, and secure command-and-control as drivers, while a separate O-RU NES setup uses R&S RTO6 + VSE to monitor dynamic power consumption versus broadcasting activity [83][86][97].**
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S RTO / R&S MXO | UAV image-processing / camera links such as GMSL and LVDS at 邑錡 | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, or software option | The source directly maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO in the UAV 影像處理-相機 category | [36][37][41] | The mapping cannot be rewritten as a formal configuration guide, sold opportunity, customer adoption, certification, or test result [41]. |
| R&S MXO | UAV motor/gimbal and battery/power electronics categories | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, current probe, voltage probe, or power-analysis option | The source directly maps 其昜先進 in 馬達動力雲台 to R&S MXO and 德鑫新技 in 電池電源 to R&S MXO | [36][37][41] | The drone source lists battery, BMS, ESC, flight-control module, communication module, antennas, and sensors as test-risk components, but it does not provide concrete EUT model, BOM, voltage, interface, or setup [59]. |
| Oscilloscope, model unspecified | Satellite / satcom ecosystem opportunities | 知識庫未標示 model, option, or specification | SatelliteEcoChain says R&S solution mappings for satellite / satcom include Oscilloscope among other instruments | [44] | The source does not provide market size, exact oscilloscope application, model, option, customer, or measured result [43][44]. |
| R&S RTO6 + VSE | O-RU network-energy-saving testing that may be relevant to defense private-5G labs | 知識庫未標示 RTO6 option code; VSE / VSA is named in the setup | The O-RU NES setup uses R&S RTO6 Oscilloscope + VSE / VSA, and RTO6 monitors dynamic power consumption of the O-RU versus broadcasting activities | [97][98] | The O-RU NES passages do not state Aerospace / Defense use, so the link to defense private 5G remains an adjacent inference rather than a verified A&D oscilloscope opportunity [83][86][97]. |
| Oscilloscope as part of drone EMC / EME investigation | Military / aviation drone RF susceptibility, RF emissions, lightning-induced transients, ESD, and system-level EME analysis | 知識庫未標示 any oscilloscope model, option, probe, transient spec, or EMC software | The vault strongly supports the military / aviation drone EMC and EME need through MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, lightning, EMP, HPM, RADHAZ, and system-level electromagnetic-environment topics | [65][67][68][70][71][72] | The drone EMC proposal maps standard systems to TS9975, TS9982, and TS8997, not to a named oscilloscope product line [63]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| UAV camera / image-processing suppliers | R&S RTO / R&S MXO | Start with 邑錡-style GMSL / LVDS interface validation because the UAV eco-chain directly maps this role to RTO and MXO | The vault does not give bandwidth, probe, trigger, decoding, compliance method, or customer requirement [36][37][41]. |
| UAV motor/gimbal and battery/power suppliers | R&S MXO | Start with 其昜先進 and 德鑫新技-style motor/gimbal and battery/power categories because the eco-chain directly maps both categories to MXO | The vault does not give voltage/current ranges, switching frequencies, probes, fixtures, or pass/fail criteria [36][37][41][59]. |
| UAV EMC / military drone qualification labs | Oscilloscope not yet verified as a mapped product; pair only after discovery with the known drone EMC / EME solution context | Use the documented MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, RF susceptibility, RF emissions, lightning-induced transients, ESD, and system-level EME requirements as discovery topics | The current drone solution passages do not map RTO, MXO, or RTO6 to the EMC / EME systems, and they do not provide test methods, frequency plans, threat waveforms, or safety conditions [55][56][65][67][70][71][72]. |
| Satellite / satcom suppliers and labs | Oscilloscope, model unspecified | Treat SatelliteEcoChain’s generic Oscilloscope mapping as a lead to qualify exact satellite / satcom debug or validation use cases | The vault does not specify the oscilloscope model, option, row-level application, or quotation configuration [44]. |
| Defense private-5G / O-RU energy labs | R&S RTO6 + VSE with the O-RU NES setup | Use dynamic power consumption versus broadcasting activity as the concrete RTO6 use case, and position it only as adjacent to A&D private-5G resilience discussions | The vault does not prove that the O-RU NES setup was used for defense private 5G, smart-jamming resilience, or any A&D customer program [83][86][97][98]. |
### 限制
The vault does not provide a ranked list of “strongest” Oscilloscope opportunities in Aerospace / Defense, so the prioritization above is based on how directly each passage maps Oscilloscope products to UAV, satellite, or defense-adjacent needs [36][37][41][44][97].
The UAV eco-chain mappings cannot be treated as formal configurations, sold opportunities, customer adoption, certifications, or test results [41].
The drone EMC / EME sources are market-style solution summaries and do not provide executable oscilloscope setup, frequency plan, chamber setup, threat waveform, pass/fail criteria, or safety conditions [3][5][55][56].
The satellite eco-chain source lists Oscilloscope only as a mapping item and does not provide model, option, test application, customer, or measured result [44].
The O-RU NES source verifies R&S RTO6 use for dynamic power monitoring, but it does not itself state Aerospace / Defense deployment [97][98].

2025RS Drone Solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。
- 來源定義 [[UAV]] 為 platform vehicle，[[UAS]] 為支援 drone operation 的整體系統，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等；並列出 battery、[[BMS]]、[[ESC]]、[[Flight Control Module]]、[[Communication Module]]、antennas 與 sensors 等 drone components。
- 來源提出 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]]：standard system 包含 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]、[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS8997]]；customised solution 包含 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]。
- 商用無人機部分，來源列出 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU、[[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU、[[ETSI EN 301 489]] 系列、[[CISPR 32]] / [[EN 55032]]、[[CISPR 35]]、[[EN 61000-4-3]]、[[EN 61000-4-6]]、[[EN 61000-4-2]]、[[EN 61000-4-4]]、[[EN 61000-4-5]]、[[EN 61000-4-11]]、[[EN 61000-3-2]]、[[EN 61000-3-3]] 與 [[ISO 7637-2]] 等線索。
- 軍用 / 航太部分，來源列出 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]]、[[DEF STAN 59-411]]、[[GJB 151B]]、[[GJB 1389A]] 等標準線索，並補充 [[MIL-STD-464]] 涵蓋 external RF EME、[[HPM]]、[[EMP]]、lightning、RADHAZ、HERP / HERF / HERO、electrical bonding、TEMPEST 與 platform radiated emission 等系統層議題。
- 來源指出 commercial drone radiated RF immunity default test level 為 3 V/m、frequency range 80 MHz to 6 GHz，但也問「Is this test level adequate for all environment?」，並指出 test level 需由 drone manufacturer 依 applications 定義，例如 higher test level 10 V/m 或 specialized test level。

2025RS Drone Solution › Drone / UAV / UAS 概念
- [[UAV]] — 來源定義為 platform vehicle。
- [[UAS]] — 來源定義為 entire system that supports drone operation，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等。
- [[Drone EMC 測試]] — 來源核心議題，涵蓋 emissions、immunity、conducted layout、radiated layout、mounting mode、idle / active mode 與 EUT / AUT 環境。
- [[商用無人機 EMC standards]] — 來源整理 commercial drones 的 regulatory compliance、emission / immunity standards、Class A / Class B 與 application-dependent immunity level。
- [[軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing]] — 來源整理 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]] 與系統層 EME effects testing。
- [[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] — 來源摘要 [[RTCA DO-160]] Section 15、16、17、18、19、20、21、22、25，並將 Section 20 對應 RF susceptibility、Section 21 對應 RF emissions、Section 22 對應 lightning induced transients、Section 25 對應 ESD。

2025RS Drone Solution › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期、版本、作者、客戶、適用國家 / 地區或簡報完整頁數；只能以 raw 轉檔日期 2026-09-17 與檔名 `2025RS` 追溯。

- [[R&S TS8997]] 只出現代碼；來源未說明完整產品名稱或用途。
- [[MIL-STD-464]] 在來源中同時出現 464C 與 464D，未說明版本差異或適用情境。
- `Lighting` / `Lightning` 在來源中皆出現，需回 PDF 判斷是 illumination 還是 lightning / EMP 語境。
- `DAV-B` 可能為 `DVB` 或其他 broadcast emission 文字；未決。
- [[ETSI 4709-x]] 的正式標準名稱、版本與 drone network testing 關係未由來源清楚標示。
- 來源列出的 standard applicability 不等於任一 drone product 必須全部測試；測試項目需依 EUT、intended environment、regulatory domain、application 與 manufacturer requirement 定義。
- 來源列 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]，但未提供 test method、frequency plan、chamber / antenna setup、pass / fail criteria、threat waveform 或 safety condition。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › 與 standard EMC test 的差異
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 對 system level EME effects test 與 standard EMC test 的差異描述包含：

- system level 依 requirements operate in fixed / operational environment。
- operational environmental conditions may have no definition。
- 分析 EM interference，涵蓋 time and frequency domain。
- standard EMC test 則 according to test methods、frequency domain、research and design work 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

passages.text:
2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。

SDR-assisted UAV security
[[SDR-assisted UAV security]] 是使用 [[Software-Defined Radio]] 在 UAV 系統中執行 PHY-layer monitoring、jamming detection、GPS spoofing / jamming assessment、intrusion detection、penetration testing 與 counter-UAV research 的安全技術方向；它同時包含防禦能力與攻擊面風險。

SDR-assisted UAV security › Jamming detection
[[Software-Defined_Radio_Deployments_in_UAV-Driven_Applications_A_Comprehensive_Review]] 摘錄多項 jamming detection 研究：

- [55] 使用 [[Holy Stone HS720E]]、[[Ettus USRP B210]] 與 [[GNU Radio]]，研究 barrage、protocol-aware、single-tone、successive-pulse jamming attacks。Spectrogram-based CNN model 達到 99.79% accuracy 與 0.03% false alarm rate。
- [56] [[BloodHound]] 使用 [[Ettus X310]] SDR units 與 raw I/Q samples，在 mobile environments 中 early detect / identify jamming；來源稱 detection accuracy 超過 99%。
- [57] [[BloodHound+]] 使用 sparse autoencoders 分析 I/Q grayscale images；在 RJP=0.5、receiver distance=10 m 時 classification accuracy 達 99.7%。

- SDR security solutions 需要處理 power、size、weight、cost 與 processing latency。
- SDR flexibility 可能增加 software modification / hacking 風險。
- Jamming / spoofing 研究常需 Faraday cage、controlled rural environment、test authorization 或 lab setup；來源不提供一般部署授權。

### 推薦先賣
1. **UAV image-processing / camera-interface validation is the clearest Oscilloscope opportunity, because UAVEcoChain maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO in the 影像處理-相機 category [36][37][41].**
2. **UAV motor/gimbal and battery/power electronics are also directly supported, because UAVEcoChain maps 其昜先進 in 馬達動力雲台 to R&S MXO and 德鑫新技 in 電池電源 to R&S MXO [36][37][41].**
3. **Military / aviation drone EMC and EME is a strong measurement-demand area but not a verified Oscilloscope product mapping, because the drone proposal covers MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, system-level EME, HPM, EMP, lightning, RADHAZ, and platform radiated emission, while its standard R&S systems are TS9975, TS9982, and TS8997 rather than RTO/MXO [1][63][65][67][68].**

5. **Defense private-5G / O-RU lab work is an adjacent opportunity, because the A&D 5G-resilience material identifies tactical-edge private 5G, smart jamming, EW, drones, low latency, and secure command-and-control as drivers, while a separate O-RU NES setup uses R&S RTO6 + VSE to monitor dynamic power consumption versus broadcasting activity [83][86][97].**

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；

- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
